children: exits outpace hirings at top six firms Tanya Pandey New Delhi: Across India's top technology services companies, exits are outpacing new hires in the IT and engineering functions. Over the last one year, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, Tech Mahindra and LTIMindtree collectively recorded 92,000 exits, in line with the industry's normal attrition rate of 11-15%.

However, with exits outpacing hiring of new employees in the IT and engineering functions in five of the last six months, overall intake over the 12 months fell by 24,422 to 68,000, data from staffing firm Xpheno showed. The combined headcount fell nearly 3% during this period to 797,722 in October 2026 from 822,144 in October 2025.

While IT functions typically involve maintaining and supporting existing technology systems, engineering functions focus on building and developing software and applications. Although these roles may overlap, their main objectives differ. "The collective count of talent in these functions has gradually dropped," said Francis Padamadan, chief executive of Xpheno. "Annual attrition has remained at 11-15%, but companies haven't necessarily refilled attrited seats." Staffing firm TeamLease Digital said the decline reflects a combination of workforce optimisation and changing technology requirements, with artificial intelligence reducing the need for routine work in some traditional IT roles.

title: Software Majors Delete 24k Jobs across IT, Engg in a Year
